definitions.explanation: The act of photographing or filming something again, typically because the first attempt was unsatisfactory. Used in photography, film production, and document processing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼやけていた→ぼやける：16967_boyakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{再撮影|さいさつえい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The photo was blurry, so I retook it.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たさ→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧ず、{再撮影|さいさつえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: My passport photo didn't meet the requirements, and I was asked to retake it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧がいかず、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{再撮影|さいさつえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: The director wasn't satisfied with the acting and repeated the retake many times.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (re-, again) and ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧ (photography, filming). The prefix ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ is highly productive: ⟦{再確認|さいかくにん}→再確認：16446_saikakunin⟧ (reconfirmation), ⟦{再検討|さいけんとう}→再検討：19102_saikentou⟧ (reconsideration), ⟦{再発行|さいはっこう}→再発行：18901_saihakkou⟧ (reissuance). This word applies to both still photography and video/film production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再撮影|さいさつえい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to retake/reshoot
- {再撮影|さいさつえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to request a retake
- {再撮影|さいさつえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: a retake is needed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{撮|と}り{直|なお}し→撮り直す：25509_torinaosu⟧: retake — the native Japanese equivalent, more colloquial and commonly used in everyday conversation
- リテイク: retake — the English loanword, often used in film and TV production
- {再録|さいろく}: re-recording — for audio or video recording rather than photography
